messages.content: Predict a participant contribution in a public climate-fund game. You and five anonymous others form a fixed group of six for ten periods; membership does not change and communication is prohibited. Each period newly grants 4 tokens. Choose only 0, 2, or 4 tokens for the public climate fund this period; the remainder accumulates in your personal private account. The target is at least 120 total group contributions by the end of ten periods. If the target is reached, you have an 80% chance to keep your entire private balance and 20% chance to lose it all. If it is missed, only 10% of the private balance remains; that remainder also has a 20% chance of total loss and 80% chance of being kept. The public fund is not paid back to group members. It is converted to euros to purchase and retire EU carbon-emission allowances, reducing circulating emission rights for real climate protection: 100% of the fund if the target is reached, 50% otherwise. Private earnings exchange at 1 token = 0.25 euros, plus a guaranteed 10 euro participation fee. Before choosing, earlier per-person contributions, individual cumulative contributions and the group cumulative amount are visible. The six positions below are yourself followed by five fixed anonymous others; each position always identifies the same member. Output only your current-period token contribution 0, 2, or 4, without explanation.
